preconditions.description: The length of txt is between 1 and 10^5.
The length of pat is between 1 and the length of txt, exclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(index, int) for index in output)
postconditions.description: Each element in the output list is an integer.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= index <= len(txt) for index in output)
postconditions.description: Each integer in the output list represents a 1-based index within txt.

postconditions.expression: output == [] or all(txt.find(pat, index - 1) == index - 1 for index in output)
postconditions.description: The output list contains the starting indices of all occurrences of pat in txt, with each index adjusted to be 1-based.
